# Phase B valid-path corpus -- RegExp construction, properties, exec/test and the
# String.prototype methods that take a regexp, plus one snippet per pattern
# construct that c_src/src/regexp.c actually implements.
#
# NOTHING HERE MAY THROW. The harness compares the stringified RESULT, so each
# line ends in an expression whose value is informative (JSON.stringify or an
# explicit String()/typeof where an array would flatten a hole to "").
# The `typeof m[k]` probes record what THIS engine does for an unmatched optional
# capture (mujs stores "", not `undefined`) -- the point is that C and Rust agree.
#
# NOTE: the harness rewrites backslash+n -> newline, so a pattern that needs a
# literal backslash-n is built with String.fromCharCode(10) / new RegExp(...).

# --- construction: literal, one-arg, two-arg, from another RegExp ---
/abc/.source
new RegExp('abc').source
new RegExp('abc', 'g').source
RegExp('abc').source
RegExp('abc', 'i').source
new RegExp(/abc/).source
new RegExp(/abc/gim).source
String(new RegExp(/abc/gim))
new RegExp('').source
new RegExp().source
String(new RegExp(''))
new RegExp('(?:)').source
/(?:)/.source
new RegExp('a').constructor === RegExp
typeof /a/
Object.prototype.toString.call(/a/)
/a/ instanceof RegExp

# --- all 8 combinations of g/i/m, via the literal form ---
[/a/.global, /a/.ignoreCase, /a/.multiline].join(',')
[/a/g.global, /a/g.ignoreCase, /a/g.multiline].join(',')
[/a/i.global, /a/i.ignoreCase, /a/i.multiline].join(',')
[/a/m.global, /a/m.ignoreCase, /a/m.multiline].join(',')
[/a/gi.global, /a/gi.ignoreCase, /a/gi.multiline].join(',')
[/a/gm.global, /a/gm.ignoreCase, /a/gm.multiline].join(',')
[/a/im.global, /a/im.ignoreCase, /a/im.multiline].join(',')
[/a/gim.global, /a/gim.ignoreCase, /a/gim.multiline].join(',')

# --- all 8 combinations of g/i/m, via new RegExp(pattern, flags) ---
var r = new RegExp('a', ''); [r.source, r.global, r.ignoreCase, r.multiline].join('|')
var r = new RegExp('a', 'g'); [r.source, r.global, r.ignoreCase, r.multiline].join('|')
var r = new RegExp('a', 'i'); [r.source, r.global, r.ignoreCase, r.multiline].join('|')
var r = new RegExp('a', 'm'); [r.source, r.global, r.ignoreCase, r.multiline].join('|')
var r = new RegExp('a', 'gi'); [r.source, r.global, r.ignoreCase, r.multiline].join('|')
var r = new RegExp('a', 'gm'); [r.source, r.global, r.ignoreCase, r.multiline].join('|')
var r = new RegExp('a', 'im'); [r.source, r.global, r.ignoreCase, r.multiline].join('|')
var r = new RegExp('a', 'gim'); [r.source, r.global, r.ignoreCase, r.multiline].join('|')
new RegExp('a', 'mig').toString()
new RegExp('a', undefined).toString()

# --- exec: null vs a match array (index, input, length, captures) ---
/b/.exec('abc') === null
String(/z/.exec('abc'))
JSON.stringify(/b/.exec('abc'))
var m = /b/.exec('abc'); [m[0], m.index, m.input, m.length].join('|')
var m = /(b)(c)/.exec('abc'); [m[0], m[1], m[2], m.index, m.input, m.length].join('|')
var m = /(a)|(b)/.exec('a'); [m[0], m[1], typeof m[2], m.index, m.length].join('|')
var m = /(a)(x)?/.exec('a'); [m[0], m[1], typeof m[2], m.length].join('|')
var m = /(a)(?:(b)|(c))/.exec('ac'); [m[0], m[1], typeof m[2], m[3], m.length].join('|')
var m = /(z)?(a)/.exec('a'); [typeof m[1], m[2], m.length].join('|')
var m = /a/.exec('xxax'); [m[0], m.index, m.input].join('|')
var m = /^/.exec('abc'); [m[0].length, m.index, m.length].join('|')
var m = /$/.exec('abc'); [m[0].length, m.index].join('|')
var m = /()/.exec('abc'); [m[0].length, m[1].length, m.index, m.length].join('|')
/a/.exec('')
String(/(a)(b)(c)(d)(e)(f)(g)(h)(i)(j)(k)(l)(m)(n)(o)/.exec('abcdefghijklmno'))
var m = /(a)(b)(c)(d)(e)(f)(g)(h)(i)(j)(k)(l)(m)(n)(o)/.exec('abcdefghijklmno'); m.length
var m = /(a+)(b+)?/.exec('aaa'); [m[0], m[1], typeof m[2]].join('|')
Object.prototype.toString.call(/a/.exec('a'))
/a/.exec('a') instanceof Array

# --- RegExp.prototype.test ---
/a/.test('abc')
/z/.test('abc')
/a/.test('')
/^$/.test('')
/A/i.test('a')
/A/.test('a')
/a/g.test('aa')
RegExp.prototype.test.call(/b/, 'abc')
/1/.test(1)
/true/.test(true)
/undefined/.test(undefined)
/null/.test(null)

# --- lastIndex bookkeeping: without /g it must stay 0 ---
var r = /a/; [r.lastIndex, r.exec('aaa') && 1, r.lastIndex].join('|')
var r = /a/; r.exec('aaa'); r.exec('aaa'); r.lastIndex
var r = /a/; r.test('aaa'); r.test('aaa'); r.lastIndex
var r = /a/; r.lastIndex = 2; [r.exec('aaa').index, r.lastIndex].join('|')

# --- lastIndex bookkeeping: with /g it advances and then resets ---
var r = /a/g; var out = []; out.push(r.lastIndex); out.push(r.exec('aaa')[0]); out.push(r.lastIndex); out.join('|')
var r = /a/g; var out = []; for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) { var m = r.exec('aaa'); out.push(m ? m.index : 'null'); out.push(r.lastIndex) } out.join('|')
var r = /a/g; var out = []; for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) { out.push(r.test('aa')); out.push(r.lastIndex) } out.join('|')
var r = /(a)(b)/g; var out = []; var m; while ((m = r.exec('abab')) !== null) out.push(m.index + ':' + m[0] + ':' + r.lastIndex); out.join('|')
var r = /a*/g; var out = []; for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) { var m = r.exec('aab'); out.push((m ? m[0].length : 'null') + '@' + r.lastIndex) } out.join('|')

# --- lastIndex set by hand: past the end, negative, fractional ---
var r = /a/g; r.lastIndex = 100; [String(r.exec('aaa')), r.lastIndex].join('|')
var r = /a/g; r.lastIndex = 3; [String(r.exec('aaa')), r.lastIndex].join('|')
var r = /a/g; r.lastIndex = 4; [String(r.exec('aaa')), r.lastIndex].join('|')
var r = /a/g; r.lastIndex = -1; [String(r.exec('aaa')), r.lastIndex].join('|')
var r = /a/g; r.lastIndex = -100; [String(r.exec('aaa')), r.lastIndex].join('|')
var r = /a/g; r.lastIndex = 1.5; [String(r.exec('aaa')), r.lastIndex].join('|')
var r = /a/g; r.lastIndex = 0.5; [String(r.exec('aaa')), r.lastIndex].join('|')
var r = /a/g; r.lastIndex = NaN; [String(r.exec('aaa')), r.lastIndex].join('|')
var r = /a/g; r.lastIndex = '2'; [String(r.exec('aaa')), r.lastIndex].join('|')
var r = /a/g; r.lastIndex = 100; [r.test('aaa'), r.lastIndex].join('|')
var r = /a/g; r.lastIndex = 1; [r.test('aaa'), r.lastIndex].join('|')

# --- the property set itself ---
var r = /ab+c/gim; [r.source, r.global, r.ignoreCase, r.multiline, r.lastIndex].join('|')
Object.getOwnPropertyNames(/a/).sort().join(',')
typeof /a/.lastIndex
typeof /a/.source
typeof /a/.global
'source' in /a/
'lastIndex' in /a/
'exec' in /a/
RegExp.prototype.source
RegExp.prototype.global

# --- String.prototype.match ---
'abc'.match(/b/) && 'abc'.match(/b/)[0]
JSON.stringify('abc'.match(/b/))
String('abc'.match(/z/))
'aXbXc'.match(/X/g).join(',')
'abc'.match(/(a)(b)/).join(',')
'aaa'.match(/a/g).length
'abc'.match(/z/g) === null
'abc'.match('b')[0]
'a1b2'.match(/\d/g).join(',')
var m = 'abc'.match(/(b)/); [m[0], m[1], m.index, m.input].join('|')
'aaa'.match(/a/gi).join(',')

# --- String.prototype.replace ---
'abc'.replace(/b/, 'X')
'abc'.replace(/z/, 'X')
'aXbXc'.replace(/X/g, '-')
'abc'.replace(/(a)(b)/, '$2$1')
'abc'.replace(/b/, '$&$&')
'abc'.replace(/b/, "[$`]")
'abc'.replace(/b/, "[$']")
'abc'.replace(/b/, '$$')
'abc'.replace(/b/, function (m) { return m.toUpperCase() })
'abc'.replace(/(b)/, function (m, p1, off, s) { return [m, p1, off, s].join(':') })
'aaa'.replace(/a/g, function (m, off) { return off })
'abc'.replace('b', 'X')
'a-b-c'.replace(/-/g, '')
'abc'.replace(/(a)(x)?(c)?/, function (m, p1, p2, p3) { return [m, p1, typeof p2, typeof p3].join(':') })

# --- String.prototype.search ---
'abc'.search(/b/)
'abc'.search(/z/)
'abc'.search(/a/)
'abc'.search(/c/)
'abc'.search('b')
'aXbXc'.search(/X/g)
''.search(/a/)
''.search(/(?:)/)

# --- String.prototype.split with a regexp ---
'a1b2c'.split(/\d/).join('|')
'a1b2c'.split(/(\d)/).join('|')
'abc'.split(/z/).join('|')
'abc'.split(/(?:)/).join('|')
'a,b,,c'.split(/,/).join('|')
'a1b2c'.split(/\d/, 2).join('|')
'a1b2c'.split(/\d/, 0).length
'abc'.split(/b/).length
JSON.stringify('a1b'.split(/(\d)/))
JSON.stringify('ab'.split(/(z)?/))

# ===========================================================================
# one snippet per pattern construct in c_src/src/regexp.c

# P_ANY: '.' (does not match a newline unless /m ... in this engine ANY vs ANYNL)
/a.c/.test('abc')
/a.c/.test('a c')
String(/./.exec('x'))
/./.test(String.fromCharCode(10))
new RegExp('a.c').test('a' + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'c')

# character classes, negated classes, ranges
/[abc]/.test('b')
/[abc]/.test('d')
/[^abc]/.test('d')
/[^abc]/.test('a')
/[a-z]/.test('q')
/[a-z]/.test('Q')
/[A-Za-z0-9_]+/.exec('__ab12__')[0]
/[0-9]{3}/.exec('x123y')[0]
/[-a]/.test('-')
/[a-]/.test('-')
/[]]/.test(']')
/[\]]/.test(']')
/[\d]/.test('5')
/[\w\s]+/.exec('a b')[0]
/[^\d]/.exec('a1')[0]
/[\x41-\x43]/.exec('B')[0]
/[A-C]/.exec('C')[0]

# anchors and word boundaries: ^ $ \b \B
/^abc$/.test('abc')
/^b/.test('abc')
/c$/.test('abc')
/^a/m.test('x' + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'abc')
new RegExp('^a', 'm').test('x' + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'a')
new RegExp('c$', 'm').test('c' + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'x')
/\bfoo\b/.test('a foo b')
/\bfoo\b/.test('afoob')
/\Boo\B/.test('foobar')
/\Bfoo/.test('a foo')
/^$/.test('')

# escape classes: \d \D \w \W \s \S
/\d+/.exec('ab123cd')[0]
/\D+/.exec('123abc456')[0]
/\w+/.exec(' abc_1 ')[0]
/\W+/.exec('ab..cd')[0]
/\s+/.exec('a  b')[0].length
/\S+/.exec('  abc  ')[0]
/\d\D\w\W\s\S/.test('1a a a1')

# numeric / control escapes: \xHH \uHHHH \cX and the fixed ones
/\x41/.test('A')
/\x41\x42/.exec('xABy')[0]
/A/.test('A')
/é/.test('é')
/\cA/.test(String.fromCharCode(1))
/\cJ/.test(String.fromCharCode(10))
/\cZ/.test(String.fromCharCode(26))
# a RAW tab inside the literal (the harness turns backslash+t into a real tab)
/a	b/.test('a' + String.fromCharCode(9) + 'b')
# the actual two-character escapes, assembled so the backslash survives
new RegExp('a' + String.fromCharCode(92) + 'nb').test('a' + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'b')
new RegExp('a' + String.fromCharCode(92) + 'tb').test('a' + String.fromCharCode(9) + 'b')
new RegExp('[' + String.fromCharCode(92) + 'n]').test(String.fromCharCode(10))
new RegExp('a' + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'b').test('a' + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'b')
new RegExp('a\\rb').test('a' + String.fromCharCode(13) + 'b')
new RegExp('a\\fb').test('a' + String.fromCharCode(12) + 'b')
new RegExp('a\\vb').test('a' + String.fromCharCode(11) + 'b')
/a\.b/.test('a.b')
/a\.b/.test('axb')
/\$/.test('$')
/\*\+\?/.test('*+?')
/\(\)\[\]\{\}\|/.test('()[]{}|')
/\0/.test(String.fromCharCode(0))

# back-references
/(a)\1/.test('aa')
/(a)\1/.test('ab')
/(a)(b)\2\1/.exec('abba')[0]
/(ab)+\1/.exec('ababab')[0]
new RegExp('(a)(b)(c)\\3\\2\\1').exec('abccba')[0]
/(A)\1/i.test('aA')

# alternation, capturing and non-capturing groups, nesting
/a|b/.exec('b')[0]
/^(a|b)+$/.test('abba')
/(?:ab)+/.exec('ababx')[0]
var m = /(?:a)(b)/.exec('ab'); [m[0], m[1], m.length].join('|')
var m = /((a)(b))/.exec('ab'); [m[0], m[1], m[2], m[3], m.length].join('|')
/((a|b)(c|d))/.exec('bd')[0]
/(a(b(c(d))))/.exec('abcd')[4]
/x|y|z/g.exec('aybz')[0]
/(|a)/.exec('a')[0].length
/^(?:a|(b))c$/.exec('bc')[1]

# lookahead: positive (?=...) and negative (?!...)
/a(?=b)/.test('ab')
/a(?=b)/.test('ac')
/a(?=b)/.exec('ab')[0]
/a(?!b)/.test('ac')
/a(?!b)/.test('ab')
/^(?=.*a)(?=.*b).*$/.test('ba')
/^(?!.*z).*$/.test('abc')
/(?=(a))a/.exec('a')[1]
/a(?=(b))/.exec('ab')[1]
/(?!x)./.exec('xy')[0]

# quantifiers: greedy
/a*/.exec('aaab')[0]
/a+/.exec('aaab')[0]
/a?/.exec('aaab')[0]
/a{2}/.exec('aaa')[0]
/a{2,}/.exec('aaaa')[0]
/a{2,3}/.exec('aaaaa')[0]
/^a{0,}$/.test('')
/<.+>/.exec('<a><b>')[0]

# quantifiers: lazy
/a*?/.exec('aaab')[0].length
/a+?/.exec('aaab')[0]
/a??/.exec('aaab')[0].length
/a{2,3}?/.exec('aaaaa')[0]
/a{2,}?/.exec('aaaa')[0]
/<.+?>/.exec('<a><b>')[0]
/^(a+?)(a*)$/.exec('aaa').slice(1).join('|')

# nesting of quantified groups
/(?:a+b)+/.exec('abaabx')[0]
/^(?:(?:a|b)+c)+$/.test('abcbac')
/((a)+)+b/.exec('aaab')[0]
/(?:(a)(b))+/.exec('abab').join('|')
/^(?:a{1,2}){2,3}$/.test('aaaa')
new RegExp('(?:' + new Array(30).join('a?') + ')b').test('b')

# /i case-insensitivity across constructs
/abc/i.exec('xABCy')[0]
/[a-z]+/i.exec('ABC')[0]
/(a)\1/i.exec('Aa')[0]
new RegExp('\\u00c9', 'i').test('é')
/^ABC$/i.test('abc')

# /m multiline across constructs
new RegExp('^b$', 'm').test('a' + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'b' + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'c')
new RegExp('^\\w+$', 'gm').test('ab' + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'cd')
('a' + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'b').match(new RegExp('^.', 'gm')).join(',')
('a' + String.fromCharCode(10) + 'b').split(new RegExp(String.fromCharCode(10))).join('|')

# /g across the String methods
'aaa'.replace(/a/g, 'b')
'a1b2c3'.match(/\d/g).join('')
'a1b2c3'.split(/\d/g).join('|')
'aaa'.search(/a/g)
var r = /a/g; 'aaa'.match(r); r.lastIndex
var r = /a/g; 'aaa'.replace(r, 'x'); r.lastIndex
